findings.title: Keep deleted submodules visible in rendered review diffs
findings.detail: The new ignore override depends on current submodule records. After deleting the last submodule and its checkout, submodules is empty, so the rendered committed diff omits --ignore-submodules=none. With diff.ignoreSubmodules=all, review-scope now includes the deletion but the command handed to the reviewer hides it. Apply the override independently of current submodule presence. This repeats the ignore-settings coverage class recorded in the preceding round.
findings.evidence: review-scope:312-317 collects gitlinks only from current real and disk indexes; a fully removed submodule appears in neither. Line 489 explicitly overrides ignore settings when collecting committed paths. Evaluating render_scope's jq expression with submodules=[] and committed=["module"] produced a committed diff command without the override. Installed Git documentation confirms that diff.ignoreSubmodules supplies the default and 'all' hides submodule changes.
